title: PRD-04814 design options for SiC MOSFET gate bias power supplies

documents.title: Design options for SiC MOSFET gate bias power supplies

discovered_via: Linked from the CGD15SG00D2 and CGD1700HB2M-UNA product pages and cited in PRD-06992 Section 6.3 and PRD-09301 Section 2.4; fetched 2026-10-09.
summary: Wolfspeed application note comparing isolated gate-bias supply topologies for SiC MOSFETs (DC/DC modules, single-channel flyback/push-pull/LLC, multi-output flyback and bridge) and presenting four flexible split-rail (Vcc/Vss) circuits that let one PCB support different SiC gate-voltage requirements with BOM-only changes.

license.notes: Wolfspeed documents carry '(c) Wolfspeed, Inc. All rights reserved'; no redistribution licence was found in the documents or design-file archives inspected. Treated as not redistributable; only original analysis and metadata are committed.

evidence_limitations: Topology comparison table is qualitative (relative cost/size/isolation capacitance); no measured data is provided.
Example circuit tables give component values without load, temperature or tolerance analysis.
Page 3 contains an unrelated paragraph about turn-on loss measurement (figure 7, 240 V, 17.2 A) that appears to be an editorial error in the source; it was ignored.
source_discrepancies: Figure 7 caption refers to a single-channel push-pull based on TI TIDA-01605 while the stray paragraph on page 3 also references a 'figure 7' for switching-loss measurement.
